verdict.rationale: Temporal documents an official terminal CLI for managing, monitoring and debugging applications. That CLI is also distributed as a Docker image, includes a local development service, and the SDKs ship a test server for end-to-end and integration tests. Together these give a direct headless automation path, but none of the evidence explicitly describes CI pipeline usage. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g. pipeline examples, non-interactive auth guidance for CI), independent hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Temporal CLI (`temporal`) provides direct access to a Temporal Service via the terminal. Use it to manage, monitor, and debug Temporal applications
The CLI is available for macOS, Linux, and Windows, or as a Docker image.
Because the test server supports skipping time, use the test server for both end-to-end and integration tests with Workers.
The CLI includes a local Temporal development service for fast feedback while building or testing your application.
